description: Java class implementing a device connection service using Infinispan cache, with health check capabilities.

classes.name: RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: Implements device connection management using Infinispan cache with health check registration.

methods.name: setCacheManager
methods.description: Sets the cache manager used for retrieving caches, with null check.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes cache connection during startup, handling success and failure.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops cache connection during shutdown, with logging.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Stores the last known gateway ID for a device asynchronously.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway ID for a device asynchronously.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with the gateway ID.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates cache key from tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache readiness.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache liveness.

methods.name: checkForCacheAvailability
methods.description: Checks if cache is available and updates health status.
